findings.evidence: Mathlib `Algebra/Azumaya/Defs.lean:34` defines `AlgHom.mulLeftRight` under `[CommSemiring R] [Semiring A]`, and line 60 defines `IsAzumaya` under the same assumptions; PR lines 191–197 use only that map, `IsAzumaya.bij`, and its general application lemma.
findings.fix: Give these two declarations separate variables `[CommSemiring K] [Semiring A] [Algebra K A] [IsAzumaya K A]`; retain the field assumptions only for `tensorOpAlgEquivMatrix`, where finrank and a finite basis are used.
findings.issue: `tensorOpAlgEquivEnd` and `tensorOpAlgEquivEnd_tmul_apply` require `[Field K] [Ring A]`, although their construction naturally works over any commutative semiring and semiring Azumaya algebra.

summary: The endomorphism equivalence remains unnecessarily restricted to fields despite being defined for arbitrary Azumaya algebras.
